skill.description: The skill family, set only when the query matched one. Empty otherwise.

hit.description: Which part of the skill this row is.

motion_value.description: Per-type motion value as a percentage, on the scale optimal-affinity's attack_mv expects.

flat_attack.description: Damage the hit adds outright, before scaling.

scaling_override.description: '-' when the weapon's own scaling applies. Anything else names the stat that replaces it, which is when a build optimised for the weapon stops being one optimised for the skill.

motion_value_uniform.description: Whether this hit's motion value is the same for every damage type. False means optimal-affinity's single attack_mv cannot express it — Establish Order's big hit is 300 holy and 0 physical, and handing 300 to a scalar triples an attack rating the skill does not use.

hits.description: One entry per hit; a skill is usually several.

highest_motion_value.description: The largest single-hit motion value. Not a sum: summing would describe a full combo nobody necessarily lands.

overrides_weapon_scaling.description: True when any hit replaces the weapon's scaling. Then build-allocate's spread, which optimises the weapon, is not the spread for this skill.

scaling_overrides.description: The stats that replace the weapon's scaling, when any do.

unique_to.description: Weapons this skill is tied to. Empty when it can go on many.

any_weapon.description: True when the skill is not tied to a specific weapon.

default_affinity.description: The affinity the ash applies by default, from AshCompat. Empty when not recorded.

uncertain.description: True for the seven families the source flagged with a trailing '?' — a hit it could not confirm, whose zeros are an absence of data rather than a measurement.

motion_values_uniform.description: True when every hit is uniform across damage types, which is when highest_motion_value can be passed to optimal-affinity as attack_mv.
